title: cfRNA_CAR_T: analysis code and data for 'Cell-free RNA Signatures Derived from the Tumor Microenvironment Predict Outcomes of CAR-T Therapy in Large B Cell Lymphoma'
description: Code and processed, de-identified input data to reproduce the figures and supplementary tables of Loy et al., Cell Reports Medicine (2026): plasma cell-free RNA from 91 patients with large B-cell lymphoma treated with anti-CD19 CAR-T cells. Includes cfRNA count matrices, sample metadata, precomputed machine-learning results, and notebooks that download and process the public single-cell reference atlases.
